final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sites.healtheval AS health_status, SUM(scans.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref COLLATE BINARY = sites.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY sites.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS overall_average FROM grouped) SELECT grouped.health_status, grouped.total_scans, grouped.avg_size_per_minute, grouped.avg_size_per_minute - overall.overall_average AS difference FROM grouped JOIN overall ON overall.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE grouped.avg_size_per_minute > overall.overall_average
